findings: Direct ClassPass pages for Upclub, Movements City, Svaha Downtown, EQUAL Rozengracht and Studio 191 Oost were attempted in the installed Chromium browser. Each returned HTTP 403 Cloudflare security verification. The native preview browser also returned its documented AppArmor host-block message. No challenge was bypassed.

ClassPass search-indexed pages remain useful for venue identity, locations, amenities and old schedule examples. Their indexed schedule dates (Sep 18 to Oct 15) precede the requested Oct 19–Nov 30 window; no ClassPass occurrence was converted into a dated event.
ClassPass credit prices are not visible in the accessible public page state and are account/session-dependent. All credits remain null; no EUR conversion was attempted.

ADC’s embedded public schedule rendered Oct 19–25, 2026 and exposes date, start time, duration, title, teacher, studio and signup buttons. The adult FAQ supports individual single-class visits at €22.50 without membership. The dates recorded here are only the visible week.

EQUAL’s public Momence schedule rendered Oct 18–24, 2026; Monday Oct 19 was selected and showed exact class rows. EQUAL prices a one-class card at €20 and a first-time offer at €25 for three classes in 15 days.

Studio 191’s public schedule displayed Oct 18–24, 2026 with location filters and visible current-week bookings. Its pricing page says walk-ins are possible, recommends booking ahead, and lists a €20 single class. No November dates were recorded.

Verified direct single-class EUR offers: ADC €22.50; EQUAL €20; Studio 191 €20; Yagoy €18; Movements €25. Intro or multi-class offers are kept separate in notes. Upclub’s verified €19 price is for a two-workout intro deal; its standalone class price remains unknown.
Language, age, budget and preferred class intensity are unknown. Individual class teaching language was not stated on the visible schedules; flagged for confirmation.

Browser method: local Playwright module at /tmp/cadence-qa/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs controlling ~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243/chrome-linux64/chrome in headless mode with --no-sandbox; public pages only, no login or booking.
gaps: ClassPass rendered schedules and pricing remain inaccessible due Cloudflare 403 in the available browser; target-window ClassPass dates and credits are therefore unverified.
The direct schedules rendered here only covered Oct 19–25 (ADC), Oct 18–24 (EQUAL and Studio 191). Public dated occurrences for Oct 26–Nov 30 were not observed and were not extrapolated.
Exact live capacity and waitlist status were not verified for ADC or Equal; ADC showed a signup button, not a seat count.
No exact dated event was confirmed for Upclub, Movements, Svaha, Yagoy or Monk within Oct 19–Nov 30. They are retained as venue/offers leads only.
